sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA -----

For the Petitioner : Mr. Rohit Ranjan Sinha, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Snehlika Bhagat, Addl.P.P .....
Order No.06/ Dated:20.04.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending her arrest in connection with Pachamba P.S. Case No.85 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498A/ 306/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per F.I.R, allegation is that informant's daughter died by consuming poison due to the frequent quarrels with the petitioner and deceased's husband.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is mother-in-law of the deceased and innocent and has committed no offence at all rather she has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that marriage was solemnized in the year 2010 and there was some dispute between the husband and wife.
Petitioner has no concern or affair in the matter of matrimonial relationship between the deceased and her husband.
He has been falsely implicated in this case without any valid reasons.
It is further submitted that the deceased might have consumed poisonous substance due to scuffle with her husband but there is no role of the petitioner.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

It appears that there is general and omnibus allegation against the petitioner and no specific role has been attributed against her of abetting the offence as provided under Section 107 of the Indian Penal Code.
Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation coupled with materials Girija Masomat vs The State Of Jharkhand ......Opposite ... on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192663427/
1 on record, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Giridih in connection with Pachamba P.S. Case No.85 of 2022 with the condition that petitioner will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish her mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that she will not change her mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
